title: Deprecation Calendar and Customer Migration Toolkit
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Create a repeatable, calendar-driven playbook and supporting artifact toolkit to orchestrate model/API deprecations and migrations across Hosted/Dedicated/Private customers. Deliverables will include a public-facing calendar, templated release notes, automated changelog generation for the Console and API docs, segmented customer migration windows, and a lightweight migration CLI to preview compatibility impact. Goal: reduce manual coordination overhead and customer churn during deprecations.
objectives: Define a six-month cancellable deprecation cadence and public calendar for all major runtime and API changes
Ship a release-notes + changelog template that can be auto-populated from PR metadata
Provide customer segmentation for migration cohorts (early adopters, standard, enterprise) and migration windows
Build a migration checklist + lightweight CLI to validate tenant compatibility against target runtime/model variant
Align GTM, Support, and Legal on notice cadence and compensatory SLAs for enterprise customers
milestones: M2: Release notes / changelog template & automation spec (2026-03-31)
M5: Pilot with 5 customers and GTM rehearsal (2026-05-10)
rollout_phases: Phase 0 - Internal runway (4 weeks): engineering compatibility tests, legal signoff, internal comms
Phase 1 - Early adopter cohort (2 weeks): invite 10 willing customers to migrate during a controlled window
Phase 2 - General availability window (4 weeks): bulk migration invitations, multi-channel comms
Phase 3 - Enterprise exceptions & support (ongoing): dedicated SRE/SE-assisted migrations under SLA
Phase 4 - Deprecation cutover (date): enforce redirects/fallbacks and begin telemetry-only monitoring for residual traffic
communication_plan: T-minus 90 days: Public calendar entry + blog post outline (PM owns content)
T-minus 60 days: Email notice to affected API key owners with migration guide link
T-minus 30 days: In-console banner on affected routes and targeted dashboard notifications
T-minus 14 days: Live webinar + migration Q&A for enterprise customers
T-minus 7 days: Final reminder + automated migration readiness check via CLI
Post-cutover: Post-mortem blog, support FAQ, and refund/credit process if SLA missed
release_notes_template:
Title: [Deprecation/Change] - [Component or API]
Effective date: [YYYY-MM-DD]
Impact: [None/Low/Medium/High]
Affected endpoints/models: [list]
Migration steps: [short bullets with links]
Rollback/fallback behavior: [explain]
Contacts & escalation: [support@redwood.example.com]
migration_guide_outline: Overview and why we are making this change
Compatibility matrix: old -> new mapping with behavioral diffs
Code samples: SDK + REST examples for common scenarios
Testing checklist: unit tests, integration tests, latency regression checks
KV/cache considerations and suggested runtime flags
How to request extended enterprise runway or custom migration plan
tasks: Draft public calendar schema and CMS feed (owner: PM)
Design in-console banner variations and microcopy (owner: Design)
Implement changelog automation that reads merged PR labels and populates draft notes (owner: Eng)
Ship migration CLI alpha that runs a compatibility probe against a tenant (owner: Eng)
Create customer segmentation queries for Growth and Support (owner: Data)
Prepare GTM kit: blog draft, webinar slides, CS playbook, social copy (owner: GTM)
Define SLAs and compensatory credit policy for enterprise affected by forced cutover (owner: Legal/Finance)
Run pilot migrations with 5 customers and capture learnings (owner: PM + CS)
risks: High-touch enterprise customers request extended timelines, creating asymmetric migrations
Automated changelog pulls could mislabel breaking changes if PR metadata is inconsistent
Migration CLI may produce false negatives on complex private deployments (network/VPC constraints)
In-console banners could be ignored if timing conflicts with customer release windows
Legal/Compliance may require longer retention for audit before deprecation
success_metrics: % of targeted customers migrated within window (target: 80%)
Reduction in manual triage tickets related to deprecation (target: -60%)
Time to generate release notes from PRs (target: < 10 minutes automated draft)
Number of emergency rollbacks during cutover (target: 0)
CS NPS change for impacted customers (target: delta <= -2)
follow_up_items: Post-pilot retro with engineering and CS to refine CLI compatibility checks
Add webhook to Console so customers can subscribe to deprecation calendar updates
Create a canonical public FAQ page and map to in-console support flows
Automate migration cohort invites from product usage signals (alpha)
